career_ladder.note: Assistant Linemen (ALM) in Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) belong to the field technical operation cadre responsible for transmission, distribution, grid maintenance, and consumer service. The career progression path provides avenues for promotion to supervisory and engineering posts through departmental trade examinations, seniority-cum-merit, and qualification acquisition.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for the post of Assistant Lineman (ALM) in PSPCL is conducted via a Computer Based Online Test (CBT) consisting of two parts administered in a single 3-hour session (180 minutes). Part-I is a mandatory qualifying test of Punjabi Language (Matriculation standard) per Punjab Government Notification dated 28.10.2022. Part-II is the competitive merit test comprising 100 objective multiple-choice questions. All questions carry 1 mark each and there is NO negative marking.

stages.source_label: PSPCL Detailed Advt. No. CRA 312/25 (Section 5.0 - Scheme of Examination)

papers.paper_name: Part-I: Qualifying Test of Punjabi Language
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (0 marks deducted for incorrect answers)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory qualifying test comprising 50 objective MCQs. Candidates must secure a minimum of 50% marks (25 marks out of 50) to qualify. Failure to score 25 marks in Part-I disqualifies the candidate from selection irrespective of marks scored in Part-II. Marks of Part-I do not count towards final merit.

papers.paper_name: Part-II: Core Technical & Aptitude Competitive Paper
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (0 marks deducted for incorrect answers)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Comprises 100 objective MCQs: Technical Lineman Trade discipline questions (50 Qs), Punjabi Language Knowledge (20 Qs), General Knowledge (10 Qs), Reasoning (10 Qs), and Arithmetic (10 Qs). Minimum qualifying marks: 25% (25 marks) for General category and 20% (20 marks) for Reserved categories (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-SM/FF/Sports/PwD). Final selection merit is drawn purely on normalized scores of Part-II.

financial_package.note: The pay scale of Assistant Lineman is regulated by PSPCL Financial Circular No. 21/2022 dated 17.08.2022, following the Punjab State Power Corporation Limited wage revision aligned with the 7th CPC / Punjab Pay Commission structure. The post corresponds to Level 2 (₹19,900 - ₹63,200) with an entry basic pay of ₹19,900. In accordance with Punjab Government Finance Department instructions (Letter No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), newly recruited employees serve a probation period of 3 years during which only the fixed 'minimum admissible pay' of ₹19,900 per month is payable without DA, Grade Pay, annual increments, or allowances (except TA and medical reimbursement). Upon successful completion of probation, regular allowances including DA, HRA, and annual increments are restored.
financial_package.pay_source_label: PSPCL Advt. No. CRA 312/25 (Pay-Scale Clause) & Financial Circular No. 21/2022
financial_package.estimate_note: Regular post-probation gross salary calculated from Level 2 minimum basic pay ₹19,900 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹11,542) + House Rent Allowance (8% to 16% depending on city classification: ₹1,592 to ₹3,184) + medical allowance and technical allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS/CPF contribution (Basic + DA = ₹3,144) and Punjab State Professional Tax (₹200). During the initial 3-year probation period, the employee draws a fixed gross and in-hand sum of approximately ₹18,000 - ₹19,900 per month.
official_perks: Subsidized and concessional domestic electricity units entitlement per PSPCL employee electricity concession rules
Comprehensive medical facilities and medical expense reimbursement for employee and recognized dependents
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF) / National Pension System (NPS) and statutory Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity
Uniform allowance, safety gear entitlement, and field risk/hazard coverage for electrical transmission/distribution operations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and festival advance as per PSPCL board rules
Departmental residential accommodation in PSPCL thermal colonies, hydel power stations, and divisional quarters subject to availability
